SELECT p.*, c.category_name as categoryName FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (p.category_id = #{categoryId} OR p.category_id IN (SELECT id FROM product_category WHERE parent_id = #{categoryId}))
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
